title: Flowverse manifest
description: One release of one flow, kept at flows/<flow>/<version>/flow.yaml for a flow of humanfia's and at flows/<owner>/<flow>/<version>/flow.yaml for anybody else's, <owner> being who owns its repository on GitHub, in lowercase.

name.description: The flow's name: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter. Equals the <flow> directory.

version.description: A SemVer 2.0.0 version without build metadata, such as 1.2.0 or 2.0.0-rc.1. Equals the <version> directory.

description.description: What the flow does, in one line.

repo.description: The public GitHub repository holding the flow, as owner/repo. Its owner is humanfia for a flow at flows/<flow>/, and <owner> for one at flows/<owner>/<flow>/.

ref.description: The tag (preferred), branch or commit the release is cut from.

commit.description: The full 40-character commit `ref` resolved to when the release was reviewed. hmz installs exactly this commit.

subdir.description: The directory of the repository holding the flow (its __init__.py, or <flow>.py), relative to the root, in parts of letters, digits, _, . and - that do not start with . or -. Left out: the root.

license.description: The flow's license, as an SPDX license identifier such as Apache-2.0 or MIT.

dependencies.description: Other flows of this index the flow calls, each by its name here (humanize1, or alice/kernel) with a version range: comparisons such as >=1.0.0 joined by commas, all of which must hold.

propertyNames.description: A flow of this index by its name here: <flow>, or <owner>/<flow> with the owner in lowercase.
